target_customer: US consumers who use AI assistants and want them to send and receive money, plus developers
problem: AI agents cannot safely move money on a user's behalf, so tasks like splitting bills, paying invoices or conditional payouts stay manual.
business_model: Consumer payments app with partner banking, balances held as USDC; revenue model not stated

founders.name: Harshith Latchupatula
founders.background_notes: YC page does not list education or roles.

competitors.name: Coinbase x402
competitors.what: Open payment standard letting agents pay over HTTP with stablecoins
competitors.traction_then: Reported about 69,000 active agents by April 2026 (secondary source)

competitors.name: Stripe machine payments
competitors.what: Agent payments using USDC and x402 integration
competitors.traction_then: Preview announced; sources disagree on launch timing

competitors.name: Skyfire
competitors.what: Identity and payments rails for AI agents

technical_complexity.rationale: Uses licensed partners for banking and payouts, so the work is an MCP server, permissioning, passkey approvals and compliance flows rather than building rails.

defensibility.rationale: Partner-provided rails and protocol-level competition from Stripe and Coinbase mean the wedge is a user experience layer that is copyable.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Stripe, Coinbase, Google and Visa had agent payment protocols in 2025 and 2026; no outcome for Versine yet.

market_need_then: Agent payment protocols from several major players in 2025 and 2026 signal demand, but consumer demand for agent-sent money is unproven. Examples on the site are splitting bills, rent and allowances.

branding.domain_note: Uses versine.com, an exact-match domain; versine is also a trigonometric term and a different Dealroom listing under this name describes an identity product.

identity.visual_style: Clean, minimal, mock chat and app interfaces

brand_strength.rationale: A memorable one-line positioning but no press found about the brand and name collisions with similar words.

outcome_analysis: Versine is an active Fall 2026 company with no exit and no confirmed funding. The founders have payments and infrastructure experience from Stripe, Databricks and Amazon, but Stripe, Coinbase and others already ship agent payment rails, so the outcome cannot be judged yet.
notes: Dealroom lists a $125k seed with no investors and describes Versine as an OIDC identity layer for agents, which conflicts with the YC and site description of a payments product; the entry may be mismatched, so no round is recorded. The page did not list founder roles; all three are labelled Founder except as the YC page states.
